about: Context wording for repository interface text and release notes, applied after the converter. The converter (apps/server/internal/traditional) already applies OpenNavo's unconditional Taiwan wording from data/opennavo-terms.json, for repository text and server-side content alike; add an unconditional replacement there, with a new converter Version. Rules here need the English source or interface keys, so server-side content derivation does not use them. They run in order: `keys` limits a rule to interface keys matching the pattern, `whenEnglish` and `keepWhenEnglish` test the English source, and `applyWithoutEnglish` also applies the rule to text without one (release notes).

context.why: s2twp renders every 项目 as 專案 (project); items, entries and purchases are 項目. The English source decides; text without English stays as converted.
